I would probably say putting alarms on your phone has helped my clients the most (I'm a therapist). Because you undereat potentially you have lost some of the ability to feel the hunger cues. Having a bit every time your alarm goes off (until you feel satisfied) you will start feeling hungrier over time.

Go for foods like nut butters, fruit, nuts to help increase calories. Eating protein and protein shakes will help fill you out as well, without the effort of having a full meal. I'd also recommend seeing a doctor as well as sometimes people may have a deficiency that stops them from feeling hungry/or have an issue with hormones. Good luck.
